question_patterns: why do I cough when dust gets in my throat
en.first_sentence: A cough pushes bothering things out of your throat.
facts: When something bothers your lungs or throat, you cough.
Chest muscles push air out with a strong blast.
Being sick, dust, or smoke can make you cough.
